title: Exceptional parameter set for the multiplicity-one graph measure
statement:
Setting:
- n, k ∈ ℕ; U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} any set, and W ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} any set with W ⊆ U.
- R = (M, θ, ξ_R) is an integer multiplicity triple in U (Lean IMRep U n), with M = R.carrier (Borel) and θ = R.mult : ℝ^{n+k} → ℕ.
- μ := R.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M) with density θ, where Hⁿ = μHE[n].
- ξ ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and r > 0 with closedBall ξ r ⊆ W, and a ∈ ℝ.
- ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} are linear isometries.
- P : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝⁿ is continuous linear with P(ιv) = v and P(ι'w) = 0 for all v, w.
- f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ satisfies |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ |v − w| and |f(v)| ≤ r/4 for all v, w.
- Φ(v) := ξ + ιv + ι'f(v), and D := ball (0 : ℝⁿ) (r/2), the open ball.
Assume:
(H1) for μ-a.e. x, x ∈ closedBall ξ r implies θ(x) = 1;
(H2) Hⁿ((spt μ ∩ W) ∖ M) = 0;
(H3) Hⁿ((range Φ ∖ spt μ) ∩ closedBall ξ r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a, where spt μ = R.measure.support.
Then μ(Φ(D)) ≠ ∞. Moreover there is a measurable set Z ⊆ ℝⁿ such that Hⁿ(Φ(Z)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a and, for every measurable h : ℝ^{n+k} → [0, ∞], ∫⁻_{Φ(D)} h dμ = ∫⁻_{Φ(D ∖ Z)} h dHⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (r a : ℝ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (P : Euclid (n + k) →L[ℝ] Euclid n) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k), W ⊆ U → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ W → (∀ v, P (ι v) = v) → (∀ w, P (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → (∀ v, ‖f v‖ ≤ r / 4) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ closedBall ξ r → R.mult x = 1) → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → μHE[n] ((range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) \ R.measure.support) ∩ closedBall ξ r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → R.measure ((fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2)) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∃ Z : Set (Euclid n), MeasurableSet Z ∧ μHE[n] ((fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' Z) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a ∧ ∀ h : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable h → ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), h x ∂R.measure = ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' (ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2) \ Z), h x ∂μHE[n]
